name.en-US: Sts. Andrew Kim Taegon and Companions
name.pt-BR: Santos André Kim Taegon e companheiros

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Everyone who acknowledges me before others I will acknowledge before my heavenly Father, says the Lord.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Todo aquele que se declarar a meu favor diante dos homens, também eu me declararei em favor dele diante do meu Pai que está nos céus, diz o Senhor.

meta.face: Andrew: a slender Korean man of twenty-five with a smooth, soft oval face, wider at the cheeks — a short nose with a low bridge, narrow almond eyes with single lids tilted slightly up at the outer corners, fine black brows, full, soft cheekbones, a small rounded chin and a small closed mouth; a thin black moustache and a small tuft of beard on the chin, black hair gathered up under the gat, and a serene, direct gaze. Paul: a sturdier Korean layman of about forty-five with a broad, square face — wide, flat cheekbones, a short, broad nose with a flat bridge, small narrow eyes with lines at the corners under thick straight brows, a strong, wide jaw and a full, wide mouth; a fuller short black beard with moustache, and a warm, earnest gaze.
meta.basis: Andrew follows the oil portrait by Louis Chang Bal (1920) and the engraving in Launay's La Corée et les missionnaires (1901): white hanbok, gat, a thin moustache and chin tuft, book and palm. Paul Chong has no portrait; he is dressed as tradition shows him (hanbok, gat, crucifix, palm) and made older and fuller-bearded to tell them apart.
